claude.performance_metric: US segment revenue rose from £10,373m (2019) to £11,473m (2020); no divestiture documented
claude.rationale: The realized record shows the acquired Reynolds business retained as a distinct "United States" revenue segment growing from £10,373m to £11,473m, with named RAI subsidiaries and its own "President and CEO (Reynolds American Inc.)" still functioning at the Winston-Salem location — no documented product/process incoherence (p4=0). The slice documents continuity of the operating business within the acquirer's filing and provides no evidence of an operations-versus-organization fracture; litigation charges and impairments are reported at Group level with no Reynolds-Group-only breakout, so no process/organization fracture is documented (p5=0). No archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is evidenced in the slice.

gemini.performance_metric: United States segment revenue of £11,473 million in 2020
gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents the continued operation of the Reynolds Group as a distinct US business with its own President and CEO, and reports growing segment revenue. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway) in the 3-5 year post-deal window.

grok.performance_metric: US segment revenue £11,473m (2020) vs £10,373m (2019); assets retained
grok.rationale: The slice documents continuity of the Reynolds Group within BAT's FY2020 20-F: named subsidiaries, a distinct RAI President and CEO at Winston-Salem, and rising United States segment revenue, with no mention of product/process misalignment or inability to align acquired products with operating processes. Likewise, no fracture at the process/organization interface is documented; litigation charges and goodwill impairments are reported at Group level without attribution to Reynolds integration failure or operations-versus-culture breakdown. Absence of any realized interface-disruption evidence yields p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0.
